name: renewal-world-gear
author: BlaXun
description: Renewal's equipment from the monsters of renewal's new lands, converted for pre-renewal: weapons and armour held to pre-renewal's best of their kind, single-skill bonuses at a third, and renewal's sets of them at a third. Each drops from the monster renewal gives it, at renewal's rate. A boss's items drop only while renewal-world-mvps is on. Needs renewal-world-monsters.
